dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How come no one's here? What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why's there a portrait of Paimon up here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And there's something written on the notice board...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #"{NICKNAME} and Paimon, there's an urgent matter I need to attend to. Please help look after the place while I'm gone."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did Jahoda know we'd drop by? What if we didn't come?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "I saw you coming in just now. Please, please, please. Help me. Please, please."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, but what are we supposed to do?

choices.text: I guess we just wait here.
